name: Cost
notes: Google's cost column; micros / 1e6 in the API

name: Conversions
notes: Can be fractional with data-driven attribution

name: Wasted cost share
formula: cost of waste rows / total cost x 100

name: Waste per day
formula: wasted cost / days in the date range

name: Waste per year
notes: Same daily rate held for a year

name: Direction
formula: flat if |change| < 3%, else up or down

name: Expected conversions
formula: clicks x account CVR, or cost / account CPA at average CPC

name: CPA multiple
formula: row CPA / account CPA; for zero-conversion rows, cost / account CPA

name: Biggest move
formula: the largest |change| among CPA, conversions and spend

name: Lin-Rodnitzky ratio
formula: CPA of all search terms / CPA of search terms with 1+ conversion

name: Spend-weighted Quality Score
formula: sum(Quality Score x cost) / sum(cost), keywords with a score
notes: Google: a diagnostic, not a KPI

name: Exact match impression share
formula: Google's Search exact match impression share

name: Search lost IS (budget)
formula: share of eligible impressions lost to budget (Google)

name: Conversions per impression
formula: conversions / impressions = CTR x conversion rate

name: Chance it's bad
formula: posterior probability that the term's true conversion rate is under half the account's (beta-binomial, prior fit on the account's own terms)
